LESSON: SARUFI 5.4.1 HALI ZA MASHARTI -NGE- -NGALI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SARUFI 5.4.1 HALI ZA MASHARTI -NGE- -NGALI
This lesson teaches Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali for Grade 9 KISWAHILI.

1. Explain the main ideas in Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

2. Explain Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 5.4.1 Hali za Masharti -nge- -ngali important for a Grade 9 learner?
